title: Retire the dead GIVE/INSPECT action surface and never-emitted dialogue event
body:
RpgAction declares GIVE and INSPECT (src/api/types.ts:22,24) but no enumerator emits them and the resolver has no case (falls to default null, src/rpg/legal_actions.ts:~515-517; INSPECT rides on LOOK at :252). GameEvent type "dialogue" (src/core/events.ts:17) is never emitted anywhere in src/. Downstream code still switch-cases GIVE (src/world/journey_decision.ts:157, src/mcp/tools.ts:375) — plumbing for actions that can never occur.

Either implement them (if a quest wants them) or remove them from the public union and the dead switch arms, so the API stops advertising capabilities the engine does not have. Removal touches api/types.ts (public surface) — check UI/blind-harness consumers before landing.

From the 2026-08-30 full audit, findings ledger P3.

evidence.summary: 2026-08-30 audit: public API declares actions no enumerator emits
